title: biomes.blast/1
description: data/biomes/blast.json: what an energy shot does to the world where it ends (sim/world/blast.gd; docs/world/ground-contact.md section 23). Per shot kind: craterE the crater's energy at tier 1, radius and damage the structure blast at tier 1 (units, hit points), the effect counts and the shake; tierEnergy and tierDamage multiply by the shooter's tier 1 to 4. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore; the kinds are an open table of closed records (a new shot kind needs an entry). Every kind in data/fight/shots.json should have an entry (a warning, blast-kind) the tier multipliers (energy, damage and radius) should not fall with the tier (a warning, blast-tier), and a full charge should be at least its tap in damage, radius and crater (warnings, blast-full).

craterE.description: The crater's energy at tier 1 (1 is a scuff: a slam at 900 speed; the bowl radius is 160 units times its square root).

radius.description: The structure blast's radius at tier 1, in units.

damage.description: The structure blast's damage at tier 1, in hit points.

ringR.description: The shock ring's radius, in units.

airReach.description: How far (body heights) an air burst of this kind reaches.

fullDamage.description: The structure damage of a fully charged shot (a charged kind), at tier 1.

fullRadius.description: The structure blast radius of a fully charged shot, in units.

craterETap.description: The crater energy of a tapped (uncharged) shot.

areaShare.description: The share of its structure damage a mine's blast deals across the whole area.

tierEnergy.description: The crater energy multiplier by the shooter's tier 1 to 4.

tierDamage.description: The structure damage multiplier by the shooter's tier 1 to 4.

threshold.description: A shot that would do less than this share of a structure's health chips it instead.

tierRadius.description: The structure blast radius multiplier by the shooter's tier 1 to 4.

areaShare.description: The share of a shot's structure damage dealt across the whole area (a mine overrides it).
